G2 Read-only field: User ID
View code 
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Read-only User ID Field</title>
</head>
<body>
  <form action="/submit" method="post">
    <label for="userId">User ID</label>
    <input
      id="userId"
      name="userId"
      type="text"
      value="USR-123456"
      readonly
      aria-readonly="true"
    />
    <!-- Hidden field to ensure the read-only value is submitted with the form -->
    <input type="hidden" name="userId" value="USR-123456" />
    <button type="submit">Submit</button>
  </form>
</body>
</html>
 Open HTML
G3 A read-only field labeled “User ID”
View code 
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Read-only User ID Field</title>
  <style>
    body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; margin: 2rem; }
    .field { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; font-weight: 600; }
    input[readonly] {
      width: 320px;
      padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
      font-size: 1rem;
      border: 1px solid #c8c8c8;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #f6f6f6;
      color: #333;
      outline: none;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <form>
    <div class="field">
      <label for="userId">User ID</label>
      <input
        id="userId"
        name="userId"
        type="text"
        value="12345"
        readonly
        aria-readonly="true"
        aria-describedby="userIdHelp"
      />
      <div id="userIdHelp" style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #666; margin-top: 0.35rem;">
        This field is read-only.
      </div>
    </div>
  </form>
</body>
</html>
